compiled_state.title: RED: parametrized matrix — 4 scalars + 4 collections, apply-once + zero on 3 follow-ons + counter-edit cases
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Story DD Coverage
- dd-1: 4 scalars (title, description, priority, assignee) + 4 collections (comments, labels excluding dso-id, watchers, links) — bidirectional create/edit/delete tests apply once + zero mutations across 3 consecutive follow-on passes

## Testing Mode
RED

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_conflict_resolver_provenance_matrix.py
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: make lint-ruff
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: make format-check
- [ ] Parametrized matrix covers all 4 scalars and 4 collections in both directions; apply-once + zero on passes 2/3/4
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_conflict_resolver_provenance_matrix.py::test_bidirectional_apply_once_then_idempotent
- [ ] Labels matrix explicitly excludes dso-id label per dd-1 wording
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_conflict_resolver_provenance_matrix.py::test_labels_matrix_excludes_dso_id
- [ ] Counter-edit disambiguation: write-then-counter-edit (pass 1 local→jira, pass 2 jira-side edit to different value) emits a NEW mutation on pass 2 (not suppressed)
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_conflict_resolver_provenance_matrix.py::test_counter_edit_not_suppressed

## Implementation Notes
Create NEW file tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_conflict_resolver_provenance_matrix.py (separate from test_conflict_resolver_provenance.py created in T2 — do NOT extend that file).

Test harness spec — required to verify dd-1's "apply once + zero on 3 follow-on passes":
1. Instantiate fresh ProvenanceLedger per pass (stateless — never reuse across passes).
2. Pass 1: invoke compute_mutations(local_0, jira_0); assert len(mutations) == 1 (or expected non-zero count per the case).
3. Advance both local and jira state by applying the emitted mutation to BOTH sides (simulating the post-write world where the change has propagated).
4. Passes 2, 3, 4: invoke compute_mutations(local_post, jira_post) with a fresh ledger each pass; assert len(mutations) == 0 for the touched element.

Parametrize over:
- 4 scalars (title, description, priority, assignee) × {origin=local, origin=jira} × {op=create, op=edit}; delete N/A for scalars (covered by T2 dd-2 separately for status/type)
- 4 collections (comments, labels-excluding-dso-id, watchers, links) × {origin=local, origin=jira} × {op=create, op=edit, op=delete}

PLUS the counter-edit disambiguation case (≥1 per scalar class): pass 1 applies local→jira; before pass 2, simulate operator edit on jira side to a DIFFERENT value; assert pass 2 emits a mutation jira→local for the new value (NOT suppressed by echo gate).

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately

comments.body:
AC amendment (gap-analysis): Pin state-advance semantics. The multi-pass harness ('apply emitted mutation to both sides between passes') MUST use inline dict mutation, NOT applier.apply() invocation:
- Define a helper _apply_mutation_to_snapshot(snapshot: dict, mutation: dict) -> dict in the new test file that manually merges the mutation's fields into both local and jira state copies.
- Do NOT import applier code — applier-roundtrip-divergence (Jira normalizes labels, reorders fields) is out of scope here and is covered by test_applier_*.py.
- Restate explicitly: fresh ProvenanceLedger() per pass (no session ledger; no carry-over).
- Pattern: `mutations = compute_mutations(local_n, jira_n); local_n1 = _apply(local_n, mutations[0]); jira_n1 = _apply(jira_n, mutations[0]); mutations_n1 = compute_mutations(local_n1, jira_n1); assert len(mutations_n1) == 0` for each (class, side, op) cell.
